# spo_site_design_rights (Data Source)

Look up an existing SiteDesignRights object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `principals` (Set of String) User/group principal names granted View rights on the design.
